title: Appearance
intro: Choose how Cadence looks. Your choices are saved in this browser and apply everywhere in the app.
note: Cadence is built around your habits and your growth, so it should feel like yours. Pick the theme and the colour that make you want to come back each day.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.hint: Used for buttons, the logo and your heatmap.
accent.adjusted: {mode, select, light {In light mode, buttons use a slightly deeper shade of your colour} other {In dark mode, buttons use a slightly brighter shade of your colour}} so their text stays easy to read.
